drop: Drop a Word document or template here to start reading
privacy: Local files only. Your document stays in this browser.
error: Unable to display this Word file
invalid: Choose a readable, unencrypted DOC, DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file. The document may be damaged or use an unsupported feature.
resourceLimit: This document exceeds the viewer's resource limits. Try a less complex document.

markdown.error: Markdown could not be exported. Try the DOCX to Markdown Converter or a less complex document.
markdown.resource: This document needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
markdown.note: Markdown preserves text and basic structure, not page layout. Headers, footers, notes, and comments appear in separate sections. Fields use their saved text; macros and external resources are not run or loaded. Some content cannot be represented faithfully. Images, charts, equations, and shapes may use omission markers; merged or nested tables and tracked changes are simplified. Check the output against the original.

legacy.protected: This document is encrypted or password protected. Save an unencrypted copy in your office application first.
legacy.noContent: This document has no readable content. It may be blank or contain only unsupported objects.
legacy.noHeadings: No recognized headings. Scroll to read the document.
legacy.reflow: Continuous reading layout. Fonts, list numbering, spacing, columns, and page boundaries may differ from your office application.
legacy.changes: Tracked changes appear as if accepted: added text is shown and deleted text is hidden. The original file is unchanged.
legacy.limited: Some content cannot be displayed fully. Unsupported objects, missing or linked pictures, and complex formatting may be omitted.
legacy.safePreview: External links, remote resources, macros, and active content are disabled. Internal references may be unavailable in the preview. Use the outline to reach recognized headings.
legacy.missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the preview.
legacy.omitted: Headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, and comments are not displayed. Text boxes may appear after the main text; complex drawings and embedded applications may be omitted.
